bead.title: Extend shared claimed-item conformance for post-update_fields fields
bead.description: PROBLEM: API-001 now requires the claimed-item shape to carry the current structured `fields` map as of claim time, including after `update_fields`, but the shared conformance coverage still stops at the original push/claim shape checks. ROOT CAUSE: `crates/pqueue-conformance/src/scenarios.rs:1804` defines the claimed-item shape scenario, yet it only exercises the initial claim state and does not re-claim after `update_fields`; the TP-001 traceability row at `docs/helix/03-test/test-plans/TP-001-governing-test-traceability.md:117` still reflects the older closed shape. PROPOSED FIX: add a dedicated shared scenario that pushes an item, claims it, mutates `fields` with `update_fields`, re-claims or reads the claimed shape, and asserts the current `fields` map plus conditional presence/omission rules; wire that scenario into the existing claimed-item-shape conformance macro and update the TP-001 coverage row. This extends the closed claimed-shape work (`pqueue-9c77d5e7` / `pqueue-922eaf00`). NON-SCOPE: RESP wire changes, backend-specific SQL fixes, and API-003 worker-flow behavior.
bead.acceptance:
1. TestClaimedItemShapeAfterUpdateFields: `cargo test -p pqueue-sqlite relational_conformance claimed_item_shape -- --nocapture` and `cargo test -p pqueue-postgres conformance claimed_item_shape -- --nocapture` both pass after the shared scenario re-claims an item after `update_fields` and asserts the current `fields` map.
2. TestClaimedItemShapeTraceability: `rg -n 'API-001 claimed-item response shape' docs/helix/03-test/test-plans/TP-001-governing-test-traceability.md` shows the row updated to include the new fields-after-update_fields coverage.
3. TestGoTestGate: `go test ./...` passes.
4. TestLefthookGate: `lefthook run pre-commit` passes.
